title: Pulse Compression Library
text: Library of pulse compression specifications, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Specification of each waveform in the library} sets the specification of pulse waveforms, {Pulse compression specifications} sets the type of pulse compression, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input signal complex-valued K -by- L matrix | complex-valued K -by- N matrix | complex-valued K -by- N -by- L array

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Index of processing specification positive integer

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Output signal complex-valued K -by- L matrix | complex-valued K -by- N matrix | complex-valued K -by- N -by- L array

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: Sample range real-valued length- M vector

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Specification of each waveform in the library
params.values: Specification of pulse waveforms in the library {{’Rectangular’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6},{’LinearFM’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6,’SweepBandwidth’,1e5,’SweepDirection’,’Up’,’SweepInterval’,’Positive’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Pulse compression specifications
params.values: Specify type of pulse compression {{’MatchedFilter’,’SpectrumWindow’,’None’},{’StretchProcessor’,’RangeSpan’,200,’ReferenceRange’,5e3,’RangeWindow’,’None’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: Inherit sample rate from upstream blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sampling rate of signal 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
